source_text: Quod omnibus aetatibus dicunt esse baptismum necessarium, ut scilicet illa creatura in Dei filios adoptetur, non quod aliquid ex parentibus trahat, quod sit lavacro regenerationis expiandum
pass_a_gloss: That they say baptism is necessary for all ages, namely so that that creature may be adopted into the sons of God, not because it draws something from the parents which must be expiated by the washing of regeneration
pass_b_english: Baptism is necessary at every age, so that the creature may be adopted among the children of God, not because it inherits anything from its parents that must be cleansed by the washing of rebirth (Titus 3:5; John 1:12–13; Romans 8:15).

choices.why: Keep the rite-name; Julian says praise of baptism is being used to smuggle natural evil.

anf_compare.notes: Victorian English of some of Julian survives inside NPNF Augustine (chiefly On Marriage and Concupiscence and related anti-Pelagian books). NPNF was not copied. Pass A is a literal gloss of Augustinus.it Latin of Julian's words only; Augustine's replies in the same locus are excluded. Julian is not first-English.

speaker: Julian and fellow bishops (Collective letter to Thessalonica, words preserved in Augustine, Contra duas epistolas Pelagianorum 2–4); Augustine's reply at this locus is excluded.
